user.title: Connect Zepp (Amazfit)
user.description:
**1. Email and password** - a direct Zepp account. The integration signs in through a separate web session, so the phone app stays logged in.

**2. Browser cookies** - for accounts created with Google, Apple, Mi or another social login. Sign in on the Zepp web page, copy `document.cookie` and paste it here.

password.title: Email and password
password.description: Your Zepp account credentials. The phone app is not signed out.

token.title: Log in with browser cookies
token.description:
1. Open the login page: [Zepp login]({login_url})
2. Sign in with Google, Apple or Mi. The watchface maker page that follows is expected.
3. Press F12, open the Console tab and run `copy(document.cookie)`.
4. Paste the result into the field below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Zepp
reauth_confirm.description: The Zepp session for {account} has expired. Provide new credentials below.

discovery_error.title: Connection failed
discovery_error.description:
